snippet.title: Bastion Rivals – Official Gameplay Trailer | Updated Gameplay
snippet.description:
Target release: 14 January 2027, subject to Steam approval.

Build the army. Break the bastion.

Wishlist Bastion Rivals on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5423790/Bastion_Rivals/

Four factions. Two lanes. Grow your economy, recruit and upgrade your forces, equip your builder, and push toward the enemy castle.

Latest native gameplay footage with updated army movement and equipment. Refreshed title cards. Arranged in-game scenes.

Single-player is playable. Online and ranked are planned for launch. Launch timing remains subject to Steam approval.

Music: Clash Defiant — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
https://incompetech.com/
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Music edited and mixed for this trailer.

#BastionRivals #RTS #StrategyGames #IndieGame Inspiration & thanks
Bastion Rivals is inspired by Castle Fight, the Warcraft III custom map originally created by geX (also known as gekko). Special thanks to geX and the Castle Fight community for the inspiration and years of castle battles.
